items.headline: Pat Surtain II leaves game at 49ers with lower right leg injury
items.description: Broncos cornerback Pat Surtain II, the player defensive coordinator Vance Joseph has said is the starting point for the team's defensive plan each week, left Sunday's game against the 49ers with a lower right leg injury.
